frames.title: Lesson 26 · Conditional inversion (Had I known…) — introduction

body: **Foco:** Conditional inversion (Had I known…) — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** blog, diário, crônica.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar inversão condicional (Had I known…, Should you need…, Were I to…) num blog reflexivo sobre decisões profissionais.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Blog: Decisions I’d Make Differently
paras: **Had I known** how demanding the role would be, I would have asked for more support. **Should you ever face** a similar offer, negotiate first. **Were I to start again**, I would choose clarity over prestige.
**Had it not been for** my mentor, I would have quit. **Should you feel lost**, speak to someone before deciding.

items.q: The writer knew the role was demanding.
A mentor helped the writer stay.
items.why: Had it not been for my mentor.

items.q: The writer prefers prestige over clarity.

blocks.body: A inversão condicional é **formal**. Retire o **if** e coloque **had / should / were** antes do sujeito.
Negativa: **Had I not known** (não *Hadn’t I known*).

items.s: ___ I known, I would have asked for support. (Had)
___ you face a similar offer, negotiate first. (Should)
Were I ___ start again, I’d choose clarity. (to)
Had it not ___ for my mentor, I would have quit. (been)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: I would have asked for more support

body: **Hindsight is 20/20.** — Depois do fato é fácil ver.
**In retrospect,…** — Em retrospecto,…
**If only I had known.** — Se ao menos eu soubesse.
**Second-guess oneself.** — Duvidar de si.
**Water under the bridge.** — Águas passadas.
**A lesson learned.** — Uma lição aprendida.
**Learn from one’s mistakes.** — Aprender com os erros.
**Turn the page.** — Virar a página.
**I would have asked for more support.** — Teria pedido mais apoio.
**And if you started again?** — E se recomeçasse?
**Had you known the role was demanding, what would you have done?** — Se soubesse que o cargo era exigente, o que teria feito?

blocks.title: Blog club
lines: Had you known the role was demanding, what would you have done?
Se soubesse que o cargo era exigente, o que teria feito?
I would have asked for more support.

Se eu recomeçasse, escolheria clareza em vez de prestígio.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: A entonação organiza o discurso: queda = informação completa; subida = há mais por vir; a informação nova recebe o foco (nuclear stress).

prompts.model: Had I known, I would have stayed.
Should you need help, call me.
Were I to move, I’d choose Lisbon.

blocks.task: Write a blog paragraph (6 sentences) with three inverted conditionals.
blocks.model: Had I known how demanding the role would be, I would have asked for more support. Should you ever face a similar offer, negotiate first. Were I to start again, I would choose clarity over prestige. Had it not been for my mentor, I would have quit. Should you feel lost, speak to someone before deciding. Hindsight is a gentle teacher.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
